bibliographic.title: Aphasia Quest
bibliographic.author: Kat and Nick and Jonah
bibliographic.description:
You have just moved in with your daughter Taylor in a new city and are unfamiliar with the landscape. Unfortunately, it's midday, Taylor's at work, and you find yourself supremely craving a chicken sandwich with some pickles. Alas, you check the fridge and there are no pickles to be found. Drat. Hopefully there is a FoodTropolis nearby. They sell the best pickles.
